# Chinmay D. Pai — maych.in

Personal site of Chinmay D. Pai, a software engineer interested in infrastructure, open-source, privacy in tech, and systems that just work. Also a hobbyist photographer and part-time gamer.

## Site sections

- [Home](https://maych.in/) — Introduction and recent posts
- [Blog](https://maych.in/blog/) — Articles on engineering, philosophy, and system design
- [Photography](https://maych.in/photography/) — Photo collection
- [Projects](https://maych.in/projects/) — Open-source projects
- [Now](https://maych.in/now/) — What I am currently working on
- [RSS Feed](https://maych.in/rss.xml) — Blog feed (Atom/RSS)
- [Sitemap](https://maych.in/sitemap-index.xml) — Full site index
